menu_options.bridge: Radio through a PIN-capable BLE bridge

bridge.title: Connect the BLE bridge
bridge.description: The ESPHome bridge must already be paired with the radio using its Bluetooth PIN. Use the bridge's LAN hostname or IP. This connection is unencrypted and must stay on a trusted LAN.

bluetooth.title: Connect a radio through Bluetooth
bluetooth.description: Use a local adapter or Bluetooth proxy. PIN-protected radios may require a PIN-capable BLE bridge instead. Close other apps holding the radio. Nearby UART devices (not yet verified as MeshCore): {discovered}

server.title: Connect to MeshCore Sender
server.description: Start the MeshCore server App and set up its passphrase in its web interface first.

error.invalid_address: Enter a Bluetooth MAC address, such as AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF.
error.invalid_host: Enter only the bridge's hostname or IP, not a URL.
error.cannot_connect_bridge: The bridge did not complete the MeshCore handshake. Check its LAN address, port, BLE pairing and radio connection.
error.cannot_connect_bluetooth: The MeshCore handshake failed. Check radio availability and Bluetooth authentication. PIN-protected radios may need a PIN-capable BLE bridge; ordinary proxy pairing may not be sufficient.
error.invalid_url: Enter an HTTP or HTTPS server URL without a path or credentials.
error.invalid_auth: Check the server passphrase and complete server setup first.
error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to MeshCore Sender. Check the URL and that the App is running.
